title: ExpandPipelineShapeResponse
description: HEL-933: `POST /api/pipeline-shapes/:id/expand` response envelope (HEL-906 cycle 7, task 3.8, BREAKING -- was a bare `Vector[ShapeStepExpansionResponse]` array). `outputs` is `Option[JsArray]`, `None` for EVERY shape today (no `PipelineShape.expand` domain contract declares an output yet) -- absent, never `null`, on the wire (this protocol's no-`NullOptions` spray-json convention), so `outputs` is deliberately NOT in `required` and carries no `null` in its type.

outputs.description: Absent on every response today -- forward-compatible only. Never populated by `ExpandPipelineShapeResponse.fromDomain`.

ShapeStepExpansionResponse.description: One expanded step. `clientId` is a synthetic per-response id ("step-0", "step-1", ...) assigned in expansion order; `parentStepId` references the PRIOR entry's `clientId` (absent for the first entry) so `steps` can be passed directly as POST /api/pipelines' own `steps[]` without re-deriving the chain.

parentStepId.description: References the prior entry's clientId. Absent for the first entry in the chain.
